defect_summary: Releases repeat validate many times: a file left unsigned, a file still naming the old version, a tag cut before a signature.
unsuitable_process: Release state is spread over many rules (planner gates, per-branch CI, ruleset check, per-file ADR signatures, release record, ship sentences, drill, tag checks), each holding part of the state and failing at its own time; no single command owns the order.
climb_steps: Issue #126: many turns in step 3 for unsigned files, stale version text and tags cut before signing.
Each past release defect added a rule with its own file and its own failure time.
No one command writes every derived file and runs every check before the one signature.

repo_touch.belief: ADR 0025: defects name unsuitable process, not agents
